# David Packer Recommends Around 85 To 90 Percent Of One Rep Max For Strength Training For Calisthenics Skills

David Packer recommends training around 85 to 90 percent of one rep max for strength training for calisthenics skills. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- Around 85 to 90 percent is kind of the best range for strength. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- You can go lighter for other purposes like stamina or endurance. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "i think around 85 to 90 percent so you're four you're three to four or five rep max around is kind of the best um yeah i mean it depends again like what you're if it's just pure strength or for your emom sets"
